notes:
What's new in 0.1.126:
- Live TV recording: a new Remove from list button takes an entry off the recording list, entries beyond the 1,000-entry limit are no longer dropped when the app starts, and the limit still holds after a restart.
- Backup: a link or other non-file in the safety-copy folder is no longer treated as a safety copy, so restore and clean-up never follow a link outside that folder. Nothing new is deleted.
- Audiobooks: old library indexes re-read M4B and MP4 parts once so their covers are repaired (chapters kept); a late Library error no longer replaces a good Series view; in the browser, choosing another tab while a search is running no longer jumps back to the library list.
- Beebo Inbox and organizer: a double-episode file keeps both numbers in its new name (S01E01-E02); the not enough space notice clears when Windows reports the same file with different letter case; when the folder you pick is itself an Extras, Trailers or Samples folder, its videos are treated as extras. Renames only, nothing is deleted.
- Library and metadata: bracketed tags at the end of an episode title are removed cleanly, a show named only with a year is matched, an Extras, Samples or Trailers folder with S01E01-style bonus names is not mistaken for a show, and library search ignores every accent mark in more scripts.
- Converter: Convert whole show finds queued files whatever the letter case in the path.
- Watch Together in the browser: a room update waits until you finish typing a word with Japanese or Chinese input, and an invalid room code in the address no longer turns a remembered room into an invite.
- Windows only. The phone app (1.73, build 145) and Beebo Auto (1.22) are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite ran on the merged changes (2,083 files); its one real failure came from a change that was then taken out of this release, and a re-run of the 289 affected files passed 289 of 289. One other test failed only from test-machine memory and passed with more memory, and one timing-sensitive test passed when run alone. Each change had a clear code review (two for protected changes), and the signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. The full suite was not re-run after the version-number change, and no person has installed this version or tried its in-app update yet.
- Release source commit 347fe4287.
- Built: Nov 17, 2026, 9:47 AM Eastern.
